**Finding: Compliant (no redline).**

Section 24 satisfies the ASSIGN preferred position on all material terms:

- **24.1** — Customer may assign without Vendor consent to an Affiliate or a successor by merger, reorganization, acquisition or sale of substantially all assets; only prompt notice and assignee assumption are required.
- **24.2** — Vendor assignment, delegation of material performance, and change-of-control transfers all require our prior written consent (not unreasonably withheld for a capable, solvent assignee), with an absolute bar on assignment to a direct competitor of ours.
- **24.4** — Our change of control gives Vendor no right to terminate, suspend, reprice, accelerate Fees or reduce service, and Vendor must cooperate with successor administrative changes.
- **24.3** — The mutual-consent catch-all is expressly limited to "other assignments," so it does not cut back the 24.1 carve-out.
- **13.3** — Licence rights travel with a permitted Section 24 assignment.

I also checked the rest of the agreement for a hidden change-of-control exit: the only related provision is 9.2 (mutual insolvency termination), which expressly states that a lawful reorganization not impairing performance is not itself grounds for termination. Nothing to flag.
